result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue related to the promotional banner image rendering.

issues.description: The green promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you') uses overlapping translucent circle shapes as decorative background elements, but they appear as flat, low-contrast blobs that look unfinished or like a rendering artifact rather than intentional design.
issues.suggestion: Review the decorative background graphic in the banner to ensure it renders as intended, with proper opacity and blending so it looks polished rather than like a visual glitch.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' delivery time badge (20-30 min) overlaps the burger image in a way that partially obscures the food, and the badge appears centered over the image rather than anchored to a corner like the other restaurant cards (which have the badge in the bottom-left corner).
issues.suggestion: Align the delivery time badge consistently across all restaurant cards, placing it in the bottom-left corner to match the style used by Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccol cards.
